title: Print Abbreviation Mechanism
description: Add a proper abbreviation-list mechanism (Abkürzungsverzeichnis) to the print LaTeX stack, generalizing the existing glossary machinery (GlossaryDefine/Gls/listofglossaries in print/tex/semio-window.sty, semio-table.sty, semio-core.sty) into a shared term-list factory instantiated for both glossary and abbreviations. Remove the dead/colliding `abbreviations` window-kind (box type, never used, squats on \listofabbreviations name). Wire it into mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex (and its -dark sibling) in the appendix directly after \listofglossaries, with entries for LLM, KI, AP, HID, REST, NGS, KET, BBSR (German, no-technical-background definitions), and \Abbr{} wired at each term's first occurrence in the body so page references populate.
